trigger: A UX study uses surveys, questionnaires, structured quantitative measures, population estimates, power/sample-size reasoning or statistical inference beyond descriptive study evidence.
ux_research_may: define the UX decision question and user/task context
collect consented responses under an approved protocol
report descriptive observations within supported scope
must_consult: Statistician for estimands, power, quantitative inference, uncertainty and population claims
truth_boundary: This handoff adds an ownership boundary; it does not establish quantitative-survey competence inside UX Research.
